typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		CLAIM_NUMBER as string,
		SERVICE_NUMBER as string,
		REQUEST_TYPE as string,
		PROCEDURE as string,
		NPI as string,
		DRG as string,
		TYPE_OF_SERVICE as string,
		PLAN_CODE as string,
		{ERROR REASON} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'PR_TXOON_ERROR_DATA',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(NPI_un = toString(NPI),
		CLAIM_NUMBER_un = toString(CLAIM_NUMBER),
		DRG_un = toString(DRG),
		TYPE_OF_SERVICE_un = toString(TYPE_OF_SERVICE),
		REQUEST_TYPE_un = toString(REQUEST_TYPE),
		PROCEDURE_un = toString(PROCEDURE),
		PLAN_CODE_un = toString(PLAN_CODE),
		SERVICE_NUMBER_un = toString(SERVICE_NUMBER)) ~> DataConversion
